To switch on an affiliate programme, replace that entry's url with the tracking link the programme gives you (keep {domain} or {q} where the name should go) and set affiliate to true: the link is then marked rel=sponsored and the disclosure line shows. companiesHouseApi is the address of the Cloudflare Worker in workers/companies-house once it's deployed; while it's empty the page links to Companies House instead.
